# ATTRIBUTION.md
This document explains how AI-generated code is annotated within the repository and lists all code that was fully generated by AI (ChatGPT).

## 1. Attribution Methodology
### Python source files (.py):
*   Any function that was fully generated by ChatGPT contains an inline comment directly above its definition:
```
# AI-generated via ChatGPT
def function_name(...):
    ...
```
Files in which multiple functions were AI-generated include a short file-level note at the top.

### Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb):
*   Any notebook cell containing fully AI-generated code includes a cell-level annotation:
```
# All functions in this cell were AI-generated via ChatGPT.
```
or
```
# AI-generated via ChatGPT 
```

Functions:
*   choose_melody_instrument(...)

Additional AI-generated non-function code blocks (annotated in-notebook):

## 3. Dataset Attribution

This project uses one external dataset:
* **`midi-classical-music`** — by **drengskapur**  
  - **Source:** https://huggingface.co/datasets/drengskapur/midi-classical-music 
  - **License:** MIT 
  - **Usage:** MIDI files were preprocessed into token sequences for training the GRU model.
